verdict.rationale: Hightouch markets itself as an agentic marketing platform with a built-in agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Hightouch's own MCP server, which lets outside assistants call Hightouch; that is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. Nothing shows the built-in agent can connect to third-party MCP servers or use their tools.
